observations: A twenty-three-position modular clock uses generator five, secret exponents six and fifteen, and public values eight and nineteen.
After one manual multiplication for each person, finish controls placed Bob's eighth power repeated fifteen times and Alice's nineteenth power repeated six times at mark two.
The ninety-multiplication generator check also landed at two; screenshot showed coincident hands and prior visited marks.
Reveal explains six times fifteen equal common exponent ninety, public versus secret values, and that this tiny clock can be brute-forced.
